schema_domains.default: tool-options NULL at construction; omitted tool-options makes loader reject corrupt preset. On native typed-object load, brush/dynamics/mybrush/painter-mybrush/pattern/gradient/palette/font initialize from current user context before supplied properties overlay. Remaining properties start at each exact class registration/default. Reader repairs tool/tool-info and preserves declared serialize_props.
schema_domains.type_rule: GimpTransformOptions is remapped to GimpTransformGridOptions in native reader. GimpPainterDeviceOptions is explicitly admitted. Other names must resolve and derive from GimpToolOptions.

schema_domains.default: Every output slot constructs GimpDynamicsOutput with its own output-type enum; each input curve constructs GimpCurve. Scalar flags and exact construct arrays are the separately enumerated owner fields.

System then user gimprc overlay existing defaults; object aggregate constructors and exact per-class registrations are separate records. Fill/stroke inherited foreground/background/pattern values are user-context-backed and serialize_props=0 in this aggregate.
